t: John Zabawa on The Great Discontent (TGD)
s: November 2, 2022 - From being forced to leave art school before graduation, to jumping straight into freelance design with little to no experience, John Zabawa has taken anything but a traditional path. We talked with him recently about what prompted his move from the Midwest to California (he’d lived in Chicago for ten years before landing in LA); the realities of living and creating as a low-income artist; how point of view may be the great differentiator in the age of the ubiquitous image; and why place and space are everything.
